lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor forty-one. Two hundred and sixty megawatts. Sable Reach is designated hostile as of oh-four hundred.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Say the reason, Control.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: The designation is in effect. The reason is not in the packet.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It's in the packet. It's the contract we brought back. Somebody upstairs would rather Ferrar were shot than deposed.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Ferrar. Anything to say?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Channel's open on his end. Carrier's up. He isn't talking.
lines.beat: Ferrar has no lines this level, and the absence is the point

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. Full Reach order of battle — plate, screens, taps, all of it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Still nothing from him?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Carrier's still up. He's listening.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: These aren't his usual crews. The plate's newer than anything they've fielded and the tactics are worse.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Meaning he isn't running this.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Meaning somebody bought his people out from under him. Same as they bought him.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, Actual advises that surrenders are not to be accepted at this anchor.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Log my acknowledgement and log that I asked you to repeat it.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Surrenders are not to be accepted at this anchor. Logged twice.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over. They're taking more off the bus than we're spending on the guns.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through the line.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Everything we have on the ring. Nothing clever.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Anchor's held. Their carrier dropped about a minute before the last wave broke.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: He listened to the whole thing.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: He listened to us kill about sixty people he hired. Yes.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor is held. Stand by for tasking to anchor forty-four.
